faro-bakery-and-coffee.pitch: Pastries out of the oven from park opening, and the first coffee most guests have on the island.
description: The bakery sits just inside the gate on the plaza, which makes it the first stop of the morning for a lot of families. Order at the counter, then find a table under the lantern strings outside.
The guava pastelitos are baked through the morning. The lantern sugar cookie is the one the kids ask for.

lighthouse-mercantile.pitch: The big shop on the plaza, and the last stop on the way out of the park.
description: Lighthouse Mercantile takes up most of one side of Plaza del Faro. It carries the widest range on the island: park shirts and hats, plush, pins, and the small things people forget to pack.
It is busiest in the hour before closing. Shop in the morning and you can have your bags held at the front of the park until you leave.
